questions.q: What common goal unites all economists in the book?
questions.why: All economists seek the best way to organize society.

questions.q: Which economic branch studies whole economies rather than individual markets?
questions.why: Macroeconomics aggregates individual markets into a single economy.

questions.q: According to the text, what happens when states heavily interfere in economies?
questions.why: The book argues states interfering leads to poorer outcomes.

questions.q: What concept did Adam Smith introduce that describes self‑regulating markets?
questions.why: Smith popularized the Invisible Hand mechanism.

questions.q: Which historical example is used to illustrate state‑driven economic failure?
questions.why: The Soviet Union's 5‑year plans are cited as a failure.
